alt.zh: 毕棚沟 · 01 摄影作品

copy.en: Glass-calm water mirrors autumn trees and misted ridges. A green-and-white coach sits by the cliff road; a few white cars further in. First snow along the peaks—travel traces small, the mountain large.
copy.zh: 湖面如镜，倒映秋色与雾中山脊。右岸陡壁旁停着一辆绿白巴士，中景有几辆白车。初雪贴着峰线，旅途的痕迹很小，山色很大。

alt.en: Red Maple on Still Water photograph
alt.zh: 红枫映水 摄影作品

copy.en: Among golden larches on the left, one deep red crown; a low brushy islet to the right. Mist and snow on the peaks; water nearly glass. One red note warms the whole cool frame.
copy.zh: 左岸金黄落叶松中夹一棵深红，右侧有矮岛灌丛。峰顶雾雪交叠，湖面几乎无纹。一点红，整幅冷调才有了温度。

alt.en: Red Heart on Snow Shore photograph
alt.zh: 雪岸红心 摄影作品

copy.en: Fresh snow and dry grass in front; still lake and golden conifers mid-frame. A large red heart sculpture on the left shore; colorful walkers scattered. Far peaks in mist—one red note waking the cold.
copy.zh: 前景新雪与枯草，中景静湖与金黄针叶林。岸左一枚大红心形装置，游人彩色衣点散落。远山入雾，一点红把冷场轻轻点醒。

alt.zh: 黄衣行者 摄影作品

copy.en: A thin dirt path crosses the green slope; lower left, a walker in a bright yellow jacket. Rocky peaks and snow behind dissolve into mist under a white sky. That one high note of color sets the mountain’s scale.
copy.zh: 绿坡上一条细土路，左下有穿亮黄外套的行人。后方岩峰与雪线被雾气遮住大半，天色白茫。一点高亮衣色，整幅山才有了尺度。

alt.zh: 雪峰下的湖与路 摄影作品

copy.en: Pale turquoise water fills the foreground, scrub dark along the near shore. A thin meadow sits before rocky peaks patched with snow and piled cumulus. Little wind; the quiet surface and mountain shade make the altitude feel sharp and still.
copy.zh: 湖面呈淡青，近岸灌丛压在暗影里。对岸草甸窄窄一条，再往后是带雪的岩峰与层积云。风不大，水色静，山体的阴影把高处的冷意写得很清楚。

alt.zh: 绿丘望雪峰 摄影作品

copy.en: A broad green hill fills the front, a faint path winding past a few small trees. Left rear, a snow peak brightens; white cloud hugs the mid-slope under clear blue. After grey weather, the mountain suddenly breathes light.
copy.zh: 前景大片绿丘，小路蜿蜒，几棵矮树点缀。左后方雪峰明亮，白云贴着山腰，头顶蓝天开朗。阴天之后的这一口气，山色一下子透亮。
竖构图里，下方是平顶建筑的小聚落，草坡起伏，阳光斑驳。上方岩峰覆厚雪，顶上压着暗云。人影极小，山的体量因此更沉。
copy.en: In a vertical frame, flat-roofed buildings sit in a green fold of hills under broken light. Above, rocky peaks hold heavy snow beneath dark cloud. A tiny figure makes the mountain mass feel absolute.

alt.zh: 雪山下的聚落 摄影作品

copy.zh: 一匹浅白马低头吃草，红缰绳拖在地上。背后是起伏绿丘与覆雪岩峰，厚云压顶。马很小，山很大，安静却不冷清。
copy.en: A pale horse grazes with its head down, a thin red lead trailing on the grass. Rolling green hills lead to snow-capped crags under heavy cloud. Small horse, large mountain—quiet without emptiness.

alt.zh: 白马吃草 摄影作品

title.en: Leading a Horse Across the Ridge

copy.zh: 草坡斜切画面，坡顶一人牵着红棕马缓行。黄花点在近处草间，大半幅是白亮的低云。人与马只占一线，旅途被缩成一个剪影。
copy.en: A grassy slope cuts diagonally; on the crest a figure leads a reddish-brown horse. Yellow flowers dot the near grass; bright low cloud fills most of the frame. Person and horse become a thin silhouette of the journey.

alt.zh: 牵马过脊 摄影作品
alt.en: Leading a Horse Across the Ridge photograph

copy.zh: 双车道柏油路呈 S 形爬升，黄线白线清晰，路面有横向减速标线。几辆车疏落地往前开，两侧是绿褐草坡与远山。竖幅把「还要走很久」说得很直白。
copy.en: A two-lane road climbs in an S-curve, yellow and white lines clean, rumble strips across the asphalt. A few cars spaced far apart; green-brown slopes and distant peaks on both sides. The vertical frame says plainly: a long way yet.

alt.zh: 盘山长路 摄影作品

copy.zh: 前景暗礁与青苔，一人立在蓝桨板上。对岸红瓦洋房、白圆建筑与摩天轮、玻璃高楼并排。海城交界，像把休闲写进天际线。
copy.en: Dark mossy rocks in front; one figure upright on a blue paddleboard. Across the water: red-tiled villas, a white round building, Ferris wheel, glass towers. Shore and city meeting—leisure written into the skyline.

alt.zh: 桨板与岸线 摄影作品

copy.zh: 俯看港池，红篷白壳小艇排成整齐行列。后方白灰游艇与岸上楼群。深蓝水面映着船体，秩序感干净。
copy.en: From above, red-canopy white boats dock in neat rows. Larger yachts and shore towers behind. Deep blue mirrors the hulls—order kept clean.

alt.zh: 红篷小艇 摄影作品

copy.zh: 前景海面飞起一群鸥，岸线绿树与红色螺旋雕塑醒目。玻璃高楼与红顶住宅挤在天际。蓝天干净，像把城市海风写成一张明信片。
copy.en: Gulls lift over teal water; green shore and the red May Wind coil clear. Glass towers and red-roof residences on the skyline. Clean blue—city sea breeze as a postcard.

alt.zh: 五月的风 摄影作品
alt.en: May Wind by the Shore photograph

title.en: Town under Clouds by the Lake

copy.zh: 高处俯看湖湾与沿岸屋舍，白云压在蓝天上。田野与山影交错，光一块暗一块，像风刚吹过云层。
copy.en: From high ground, a lake bay and shoreline houses sit under white clouds on blue. Fields and hills patch light and shade—as if wind just moved the cloud.

alt.zh: 云下湖城 摄影作品
alt.en: Town under Clouds by the Lake photograph

title.en: Light Through Cloud into the Valley

copy.zh: 头顶厚云，山坡沉在冷蓝阴影里。一束软光忽然落到谷底草场与屋舍，把翠绿托亮。路细细绕过村落，像一场短暂的晴。
copy.en: Thick cloud overhead; the slopes stay in cool blue shadow. Soft light falls suddenly on meadows and houses in the valley, lifting the green. A thin road winds past the settlement—a brief spell of clear weather.

alt.zh: 云隙照进谷底 摄影作品
alt.en: Light Through Cloud into the Valley photograph

copy.zh: 高处俯看，深红寺群金顶层层，一处转经亭落在底部中央。山上小红屋密到几乎没有空隙，窄路与一抹蓝车穿行其间。阴天把颜色压得沉稳，不刺眼。
copy.en: From above, crimson temples stack golden roofs; a prayer-wheel pavilion sits at bottom center. Small red houses pack the slope with almost no gaps; a narrow road and a blue truck thread through. Overcast light keeps the colors deep and calm.

alt.zh: 谷中金顶 摄影作品

copy.zh: 一行红袍沿木廊走远，身影略有虚化。右侧金顶与龙形檐饰占住中景，彩绘与木栏细密。背后雪山压在阴云下，暖金与冷山并置，节奏慢。
copy.en: A line of maroon robes walks away along the wooden path, slightly soft with motion. Golden roofs and dragon eaves hold the middle right, painted details and carved rails close by. Snow peaks wait under cloud—warm gold against cold mountain, a slow rhythm.

alt.zh: 红袍远去 摄影作品

copy.zh: 暗红木屋密布山坡，黄栏混凝土阶折线爬升。两名红衣身影走在中段，白灯与电线杆点缀其间。阴天光平，红与黄的对比干净，不喧闹。
copy.en: Dark red wooden houses pack the slope; a concrete stair with yellow rails zigzags upward. Two figures in maroon climb mid-frame; white lamps and poles sit among the roofs. Flat overcast light—red against yellow, clean and quiet.

alt.zh: 黄栏石阶 摄影作品

copy.zh: 天空是淡紫与淡蓝，横云带着浅粉。近处雪峰仍冷，远处那座圆顶山却被金光轻轻盖住。树影与裸岩点缀雪坡，像旅途里短暂的停顿。
copy.en: The sky is pale violet and blue; a band of cloud holds soft pink. Near snow stays cold, while a rounded far peak wears a light of gold. Trees and bare rock punctuate the slopes—a brief pause on the journey.

alt.zh: 晨昏之间 摄影作品

copy.zh: 前景一棵苍松，下部犹有针叶，上部枝干已银白裸露。身后是蓝绿相间的山湖，远峰隐在薄云里。树与水对望，时间感比景色更重。
copy.en: A weathered pine stands in front—needles still cling below, while the upper limbs turn bare and silver. Behind it, a turquoise lake and forested ridges fade into soft cloud. Tree and water face each other; time feels heavier than scenery.

alt.zh: 枯枝望湖 摄影作品
alt.en: Weathered Pine Over the Lake photograph

copy.zh: 布满苔藓的枯枝横入画面，阳光在湖蓝水面撒开细碎反光。远岸密林深暗，与近处的亮形成对照。一根旧枝，足够撑起整片闪烁。
copy.en: A lichen-covered bare limb cuts across the frame; sunlight breaks into countless glints on turquoise water. The far bank’s forest stays dark, sharpening the brilliance nearby. One weathered branch is enough to hold the sparkle.

alt.zh: 苔枝与碎光 摄影作品

copy.zh: 浅溪沿暗石台层层跌落，白线细密，苔草贴在岩沿。两岸深绿收得很紧，水声像把整条谷压成一条窄而干净的节奏。
copy.en: A shallow creek spills over dark stone ledges in thin white sheets, moss clinging to each lip. Dense green banks close in, turning the valley into one quiet, measured rhythm.

alt.zh: 阶梯落水 摄影作品

copy.zh: 湿透的红褐石径直伸进林深处，两侧针叶垂得很低。没有行人，只有路面上的天光，静得像一场刚停的雨。
copy.en: A rain-darkened reddish path runs deep into evergreens, needles hanging low. Empty of people, the stones hold only sky-glow—quiet as rain just ended.

alt.zh: 雨后石径 摄影作品

title.en: A Blue Bike on the Autumn Bend

copy.zh: 沥青小径在秋色里转弯，白衣骑手推着一辆青绿单车缓缓前行。金黄枝叶占满画面上方，像把午后轻轻框住。
copy.en: An asphalt path bends through autumn; a rider in white guides a turquoise bike along the curve. Golden foliage fills the upper frame and softens the afternoon.

alt.zh: 秋径上的一辆蓝车 摄影作品
alt.en: A Blue Bike on the Autumn Bend photograph

copy.zh: 前景叶片虚成绿框，运河贴着锈红水杉向前延伸。远处拱桥与行人很小，整条岸线像被季节整齐排过一遍。
copy.en: Blurred leaves frame a canal that runs beside a line of rust-red dawn redwoods. A distant arch bridge and small figures keep the bank orderly and seasonal.

alt.zh: 运河旁的秋列 摄影作品
alt.en: Autumn Line by the Canal photograph

copy.zh: 红褐步道上人影疏落，童帽一抹红。树影横铺路面，黄绿枝叶交叠成廊，午后被慢慢走散。
copy.en: Sparse figures move along a reddish lakeside path, a child’s red hat bright in the light. Tree shadows stripe the ground beneath a yellow-green canopy.

alt.zh: 湖岸秋日闲步 摄影作品

title.en: Round Sun at the Pink-Blue Edge

copy.zh: 正圆太阳贴在薄云上，上方金橙，下方山海沉入粉紫与靛蓝。高处视野把黎明压成一条干净的色带。
copy.en: A round sun sits on thin cloud—gold above, mountains sinking into pink-violet and indigo below. Height reduces dawn to one clean band of color.

alt.zh: 圆日与粉蓝交界 摄影作品
alt.en: Round Sun at the Pink-Blue Edge photograph

copy.zh: 暗云压顶，雪峰一线被橘金点亮，腰间缠着薄雾。冷调山谷衬出那几分钟的暖，像一天里最短的庆典。
copy.en: Dark cloud above, a line of snow peaks lit gold-orange, mist at their waists. Cool valleys frame those few warm minutes like a brief rite of day.

alt.zh: 日照金山 摄影作品

copy.zh: 灰褐高原上，浅水洼旁站着极小的人影。雪峰贴着低云横贯，天空苍白，尺度被风重新量过。
copy.en: Tiny figures stand by a shallow pool on grey-brown highland. Snow ridges run under low cloud; a pale sky recalibrates the scale.

alt.zh: 浅水与雪脊 摄影作品

copy.zh: 沥青路在密林与村舍间弯折前行，旁侧溪流与石桥相伴。远处高架横过谷地，阴天的光把绿压得很深。一条路，把山里与山外轻轻连上。
copy.en: An asphalt road bends between dense woods and village roofs, a stream and stone bridge running alongside. A viaduct crosses the valley far ahead under soft overcast light. One road quietly joins the hills to the world beyond.

alt.zh: 山路回转 摄影作品

copy.zh: 高处俯见棋盘般的田地与聚落，湖面嵌在远山之前。云影在坡上移动，亮处与暗处交替。大地铺开得很大，像一张慢慢翻开的地图。
copy.en: From above, fields and a settlement grid the valley; a lake sits before distant ridges. Cloud shadow slides across the slopes, light and dark trading places. The land opens wide—like a map turned slowly.

alt.zh: 田野与湖岸 摄影作品
alt.en: Fields, Lake, and Cloud Shadow photograph

copy.zh: 枝叶虚成前景，谷底密密的浅色屋顶铺向远山。天光偏冷，山脊泛一点暖意。城市缩成纹理，山仍是主句。
copy.en: Blurred foliage frames a dense carpet of pale roofs filling the valley floor. The light runs cool; a soft warmth touches the nearer ridges. The town becomes texture; the mountains keep the sentence.

alt.zh: 薄暮山谷城 摄影作品
alt.en: Valley Town at Soft Dusk photograph

copy.zh: 人蹲在木板栈道旁，指尖刚触到清浅急流。四周绿植与黄花簇拥，水声仿佛能听见。旅途里这样的停顿，往往比远景更难忘。
copy.en: Crouched on wooden planks, a hand reaches until fingertips meet the clear, quick stream. Green foliage and yellow flowers crowd the banks. Such a pause on the road often stays longer than any wide vista.

alt.zh: 溪边伸手 摄影作品

copy.zh: 两条缆线收向山脊，绿椅一节节穿进针叶林。身后的人背影近在眼前，前方的路却长得看不见尽头。
copy.en: Two cables run toward the ridge; green chairs thread a conifer corridor. Passengers sit close behind, while the line ahead disappears into length.

alt.zh: 林间索道 摄影作品

copy.zh: 大山夹出宽谷，坡面绿褐交错。谷底一点红顶小屋，土路绕过，人烟在风景里只占指甲大小。
copy.en: Mountains open a wide valley, slopes green and brown. A red-roofed hut on the floor, a dirt track nearby—human life the size of a fingernail.

alt.zh: 谷底孤舍 摄影作品
alt.en: Lone Shelter in the Valley photograph

copy.zh: 从高处俯看U形谷，河水一弯弯银色前行。公路贴着谷底远去，云影落在湿地与秋色灌丛上。
copy.en: Looking down a U-shaped valley, the river silver-bends ahead. A road follows the floor away; cloud shadow falls on wetland and autumn scrub.

alt.zh: 蛇形河湾 摄影作品

copy.zh: 老人单腿踢毽，羽毛刚离脚。前景孩童虚影看着，三角梅与绿植围着广场，活力落在平常天。
copy.en: An elder kicks a shuttlecock on one leg; feathers just leave the foot. A child’s blur watches; bougainvillea and greenery ring the plaza—vitality on an ordinary day.

alt.zh: 毽子腾空 摄影作品

copy.zh: 老人抛起粉绿彩球，女孩抬眼追着看。竹叶与砖墙围着小院，玩耍把时间变得很短。
copy.en: An elder tosses pink-and-green pom-poms; a girl looks up to follow. Bamboo and brick enclose a small yard—play making time feel short.

alt.zh: 彩球与孩童 摄影作品

copy.zh: 花草坡上，几匹鞍马低头吃草，两个人影一立一蹲。远山被低云罩住，色调灰绿。旅途里的停顿，不喧哗，只留下皮具与织毯的一点颜色。
copy.en: On a flowered slope, saddled horses graze while two figures stand and crouch. Distant ridges sit under low cloud in muted greens. A pause on the trail—quiet, with only saddle cloths for color.

alt.zh: 马队歇脚 摄影作品

copy.zh: 右下两人，一立一坐，望向层层绿谷与远山。谷中有小聚落，土路蜿蜒。云很厚，绿很满，人只是尺码。
copy.en: Lower right, two figures—one standing, one seated—face layered green valleys and far ridges. A small settlement, winding tracks. Heavy cloud, full green; people only for scale.

alt.zh: 两人看山 摄影作品

copy.zh: 谷底一簇白墙红檐的屋舍，被新绿和枯黄的草坡托着。中景丘陵一层层后退，远峰罩着蓝雾，顶上薄雪。焦距把距离压扁，人烟显得很小。
copy.en: A cluster of white walls and red eaves sits in the valley, held by slopes of new green and dry gold. Rolling hills recede in layers; the far peak holds blue haze and a skim of snow. Telephoto compression makes the settlement feel very small.

alt.zh: 层峦下的红檐 摄影作品
alt.en: Red Eaves Under Layered Ridges photograph

copy.zh: 深色山脊覆着斑驳薄雪，积云在头顶柱状升起，边缘受光，基部偏暗。山脚一排铁塔和电线横过，细得像被风拉直的线。蓝白与炭褐对峙，冷，却很开阔。
copy.en: Dark ridges hold a dappled skim of snow; a cumulus column rises overhead—lit edges, a shaded base. A line of pylons and wires crosses the foot of the slope, thin as if pulled taut by wind. Blue-white against charcoal brown: cold, and open.

alt.zh: 雪斑与积云 摄影作品

copy.zh: 白雪覆在几座圆脊上，积云铺满蓝天，云隙里有光洒下来。中景铁塔连成一条亮线，横过暗谷；左下盘山公路细细弯着。天空比山更大，人的痕迹只是轻轻一笔。
copy.en: Snow lies on rounded ridges; cumulus fills the blue, light spilling through the gaps. A bright run of pylons crosses the dark valley; a mountain road curves thinly at lower left. The sky is larger than the mountains—human traces only a light mark.

alt.zh: 雪岭银线 摄影作品

title.en: Twin Towers on the Snow Slope

copy.zh: 深蓝天空衬着碎白积云，雪峰参差。坡上残雪与深色灌丛斑驳交错，两座铁塔立在近处，下面有一条细路。冷，干净，结构和雪分得清清楚楚。
copy.en: A deep-blue sky holds broken white cloud over staggered snow peaks. Patchy snow and dark scrub tessellate the slope; two pylons stand near, a thin road below. Cold and clean—structure and snow kept distinct.

alt.zh: 雪坡双塔 摄影作品
alt.en: Twin Towers on the Snow Slope photograph

title.en: A Burst of Light in the Valley

copy.zh: 山坡沉在深蓝阴影里，盘山公路弯成一道亮线，一辆车正走在弯里。谷底忽然亮起一团刺目的反光，把屋顶和水面一并点着。冷色铺满全景，只留这一处白。
copy.en: Slopes sink into deep navy shadow; the mountain road curves as a bright thread, one car in the bend. At the valley floor, a hard glare of light catches roofs and water at once. Cool tones fill the frame—only that white remains.

alt.zh: 谷底一束光 摄影作品
alt.en: A Burst of Light in the Valley photograph

copy.zh: 一列尖峰排开，雪面受着冷而薄的晚光，阴坡沉成蓝灰。天空有一层淡云，远峰若隐若现。没有人迹，只有体积和安静。
copy.en: A line of sharp peaks stands in thin, cool evening light; the shadowed faces fall to blue-grey. A veil of cloud sits in the sky, farther summits only half seen. No human trace—only volume and quiet.

alt.zh: 暮色雪峰 摄影作品

copy.zh: 主峰顶上压着一团圆厚的帽云，边缘被晚光染成浅粉。两侧雪岭退开，近处岩脊还留着冷影。蓝天干净，山把一天里最后的暖意收在最高处。
copy.en: A thick, rounded cap cloud sits the main summit, its edge flushed pale pink by late light. Snow ridges fall away on both sides; the near rock still holds cold shadow. The sky is clean—the mountain keeps the day’s last warmth at its highest point.

alt.zh: 帽云雪峰 摄影作品
alt.en: Cap Cloud Over the Summit photograph

copy.zh: 近处一座尖顶山脊剪成黑影，后面层峦淡去。厚云横在日边，边缘烧着亮金，天上的薄云也被染成暖橙。山已经暗尽，光都还给了天空。
copy.en: A sharp ridge cuts a black silhouette; farther ranges fade behind it. A heavy cloud lies across the sun, edges burning gold, the upper wisps washed warm orange. The mountains have gone dark—the light given back to the sky.

alt.zh: 金霞压岭 摄影作品
alt.en: Gold Sky Over Dark Ridges photograph

copy.zh: 暗处的针叶从近处探进来，框住一湖细碎的波光。对岸新绿浓密，草地上有人和一顶浅色帐篷，显得很小。水是灰绿的，风在上面轻轻写字。
copy.en: Dark conifer branches lean in from close, framing a lake of fine, broken glitter. The far bank is dense with new green; tiny figures and a pale tent sit on the grass. The water is grey-green, the wind writing lightly across it.

alt.zh: 枝影下的湖 摄影作品

copy.zh: 几头褐牛与花牛散在一条条鲜绿的浅滩上低头吃草。水面把滩地隔成平行的色带，后景是石头、枯木和深林。安静，像把高原的一天铺成绿与灰。
copy.en: Brown and piebald cattle graze heads-down on bright green shoals. Water cuts the ground into parallel bands; rocks, driftwood and deep forest hold the back. Quiet—as if a highland day were laid out in green and grey.

alt.zh: 浅滩牧牛 摄影作品

copy.zh: 近处草绿坡面翻起来，空阔而近。谷左红檐屋舍贴着树丛，左山被云影压暗，右岭还在阳光里。厚云走得很快，阴晴就写在同一道山谷里。
copy.en: A green slope lifts in the foreground, close and open. Red-eaved houses sit among trees at left in the valley. Cloud-shadow darkens the left mountain while the right ridges stay in sun. The heavy cloud is moving—sun and shade written in one valley.

alt.zh: 草坡与云影 摄影作品

copy.zh: 一只旱獭从土洞里探出头，嘴微张，像刚醒。身旁一块灰石，几朵小白花开在矮灌丛边。后面土坎和草坡虚过去，注意力全在这双眼睛上。
copy.en: A marmot looks out of its burrow, mouth slightly open, as if just awake. A grey stone sits beside it; a few small white flowers open at the low shrubs. The bank and slope fall soft behind—attention held by those eyes.

alt.zh: 出洞的旱獭 摄影作品

copy.zh: 几座白墙红顶的院落落在谷底树丛里，金饰在屋顶上轻轻发亮。后面青山高耸，一条浅色的路从坡上折下来。前景树木齐整，像把一座寺院轻轻放进草场。
copy.en: White-walled, red-roofed courtyards sit among trees on the valley floor, gold trim catching lightly on the roofs. A high green mountain rises behind; a pale path zigzags down the slope. The near trees stand even—as if a monastery had been set down gently in the meadow.

alt.zh: 谷中红檐 摄影作品
alt.en: Red Eaves in the Valley photograph

title.en: A Long Road Across the Moor

copy.zh: 一条浅色公路在褐色草甸上弯着延伸，翻过一处垭口。近坡枯黄，远处岭谷已是深绿，更远的雪峰停在云下。路上几乎看不见车，风好像比路更先到。
copy.en: A pale road bends across brown moorland and climbs a pass. The near slopes are withered gold; farther ridges turn deep green, and snow peaks wait under cloud. Almost no cars—the wind seems to arrive before the road does.

alt.zh: 草甸长路 摄影作品
alt.en: A Long Road Across the Moor photograph
